name: sparx — Institution News
tagline: An authoritative newsroom template for an institution that reports and belongs to a place.
description: A curated institutional newsroom for a university, hospital system, museum or agency — a marquee research lead over a rail of the day’s stories, a live feed, a departments directory, an upcoming-events band, and a bespoke bylined research writeup, in a paper-ground navy-primary + crimson-accent serif theme. Shipped as the Northgate University news office, with a light university-press + alumni store to demo content + commerce together.
